releases.notes:
Made for the Reign server: lets the server know when a player is typing in chat.

- `/talking start` once the player actually types into the chat, `/talking stop` when it closes or he falls idle for 30 seconds
- Opening the chat to read it back sends nothing, and the first 1.5 seconds of a chat session are ignored
- Both commands go straight down the connection: they never show up in the chat or in the input history
- Mirrors the vanilla spam counter, so quick chat toggling can never get a player kicked

Minecraft 1.21.6 - 1.21.8, Fabric. Requires Fabric API. The `/talking` command itself has to exist on the server.
